comment: Outcome from item 2 (item 1 only re-qualifies the appeal). #22 Art. 8 NAG: NAG is a repealed Swiss federal act (1891), not cantonal/foreign, so STATUTE rather than OTHER_LAW; unsettled whether repealed federal acts without SR number are STATUTE. #47/#48 Art. 12 / § 3 Abs. 1 followed by dt.
